automaticallyChecksNasForChangesNotebook: Automatically checks the NAS for changes to notebooks and notes. The default is 5 minutes and the minimum is 1 minute.
changesTakeEffectImmediatelyAndSavedThis: Changes take effect immediately and are saved in this browser.
fontSizeAppliesBodyEditorsLineNumbersAnd: Font size applies to the body editors. Line numbers and wrapping apply to the Markdown editor.
handDrawnStyleChangesShapesAndLinesSuppo: Hand-drawn style changes the shapes and lines in supported diagrams.
